Du pflegst unsere Website, kümmerst dich um On-Page-SEO und steigerst Schritt für Schritt unsere Sichtbarkeit.

Du optimierst laufende Kampagnen und testest neue Ansätze.

Du behältst die Zahlen im Blick, erstellst Reportings und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab.

Du schaust dir neue Tools an und teilst, was sich bewährt, mit dem Team.

Du arbeitest eng mit Content, Design und Vertrieb zusammen und berichtest an den Head of Marketing.

Deine Qualifikationen:
Erste Erfahrung im Online-Marketing, gern auch aus Ausbildung oder Werkstudentenjob

Du hast schon mit einem Content-Management-System gearbeitet, idealerweise WordPress

Grundkenntnisse in Google-, Bing- und Social-Ads, SEO und Webanalyse (z. B. Google Analytics, Search Console)

Du arbeitest gern analytisch, selbstständig und packst Dinge an

Sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch

description:
Die steigenden Energiekosten treffen jeden Haushalt. Wir senken, was gerade am meisten wehtut.

Enter ist die Antwort auf eine Frage, die sich gerade Millionen Hausbesitzer stellen: Nicht ob ihr Haus elektrifiziert wird – sondern wie, und mit wem. Als Deutschlands führender Energieberater mit über 40 Millionen Euro Funding und über 90 Mitarbeitern sind wir erfahrene Pioniere in einem Markt, der gerade erst so richtig losgeht. 

Enter. Jetzt ist der Moment. 

Die Fakten.

Start: Januar/Februar 2027

Gehalt: €40.000-50.000 brutto pro Jahr

Arbeitsort: Büro an der Spree (Schlesische Str. 26, 10997 Berlin)

Homeoffice Möglichkeiten

Arbeitszeit: Vollzeit (40h/w) und flexible Arbeitszeiten (spätester Beginn um 9:30 Uhr)

Benefits: Learning-Budget, Urban Sports Clubs, Jobticket- oder Kita-Zuschuss; Betriebliche Altersvorsorge; Team-Events, die nicht langweilig werden

Was Du machen wirst.

Du gestaltest mit mir, Daniel (People Lead) und meinem Kollegen die neuen Strukturen unseres People Departments. Dein erster Fokus wird das Recruiting verschiedener Rollen und ein starkes Onboarding sein.

summary: Sie möchten eine moderne IT-Infrastruktur aktiv mitgestalten und die Themen Netzwerk, Virtualisierung und IT-Sicherheit vorantreiben? In dieser Position als IT-Netzwerk- und Sicherheitsspezialist…
description:
Sie möchten eine moderne IT-Infrastruktur aktiv mitgestalten und die Themen Netzwerk, Virtualisierung und IT-Sicherheit vorantreiben?
In dieser Position als IT-Netzwerk- und Sicherheitsspezialist (m/w/d) übernehmen Sie Verantwortung für den stabilen und sicheren Betrieb komplexer IT-Systeme. Dabei verbinden Sie fundiertes Infrastruktur-Know-how mit modernen Security-Konzepten und gestalten die technologische Weiterentwicklung der IT-Landschaft aktiv mit.
Ihre Aufgaben
Verantwortung für den sicheren Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung der IT Infrastruktur, Virtualisierungs- und Backup-Umgebungen

Implementierung von Sicherheitsstandards sowie Durchführung von Patch-, Schwachstellen- und Risikomanagement

Fundierte Kenntnisse in IT-Infrastruktur, Netzwerkadministration, IT-Security und Virtualisierung (Proxmox VE, Veeam)

Erfahrung mit Routing, Switching, Firewalls, SD-WAN, Zero Trust, NAC sowie idealerweise macmon und 802.1X

About Zip
Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. title: Forward Deployed Hardware Engineer
summary: Our software decides every 15 minutes what a battery should do. You own the layer that makes it happen: our EMS, the interface between our optimizer and every battery we connect. Whether we build our…
description:
Our software decides every 15 minutes what a battery should do. You own the layer that makes it happen: our EMS, the interface between our optimizer and every battery we connect. Whether we build our own EMS or integrate existing ones is a call you'll help us make.
Own our EMS integration layer: one clean interface that connects any storage system (inverter, BMS, site controller) to our optimizer

Onboard new vendors over Modbus, MQTT and vendor APIs, so the next battery is a config, not a project

Commission systems on site until the battery follows the plan to the kW

Build our own edge box on standard hardware (think Raspberry Pi on a DIN rail)

You Will Have Fun If You Are
Builder with agency
Get-shit-done mentality: you'd rather drive to the site than wait for a support ticket

High ownership: the EMS interface is yours, from the vendor call to go-live

Mission-driven
Passionate about energy transition and climate impact

Thrive in early-stage chaos (e.g. "Can you be in Ingolstadt tomorrow at 8?")

You Won't Have Fun If You
Like to follow processes. We don't have any.

Want to work remotely. We're in the office 5 days/week, and regularly on site at customers.

Want to stay on one side of the wall. This is half software, half hardware.

Qualifications
Hands-on experience with energy management systems (EMS) for battery storage, PV or C&I sites. Ideally you've built or integrated one yourself, whether at work, in your thesis or during an internship. Similar experience…

summary: We are a growing SaaS start-up with an international team, operating on the intersection between two of the world's most fascinating industries - global shipping and global travel. Over 90% of global…
description:
We are a growing SaaS start-up with an international team, operating on the intersection between two of the world's most fascinating industries - global shipping and global travel.
Over 90% of global trade depends on ships, and the shipping industry depends on the 2 million seafarers who operate them. What most people don't know is there's a complex, mission-critical travel operation going on 24/7 to bring seafarers to the ships where they're needed, when they're needed. That's called crew logistics, and without it, global trade wouldn't function.
But it's an operation often built on manual processes and legacy systems, meaning high-stress for operators, an unreliable experience for seafarers, and poor outcomes for the industry. That is until Tilla enters the scene.
Backed by strong investor support, with more than 10,000 crew changes executed in the platform each year across over 600 vessels globally, our platform is a game changer in crew logistics, streamlining collaboration between operators and seafarers, making crew operations more humane, efficient, and cost-effective.
Join us on the next chapter of our growth journey and tackle this overlooked yet critical global challenge: every crew change, optimized and digital.

Ideally you come with a first-hand experience working with SEM. You will initially work alongside our SEM experts to deepen your knowledge learn the tool’s operating principles, procedures and inspection requirements for our specific use cases. Through hands-on training and continuous knowledge transfer, you will build your skills in sample handling, imaging, measurement and troubleshooting; before gradually becoming an independent SEM user and taking greater ownership of the tool and the processes.
As the function develops, there may also be opportunities to operate additional defect-inspection tools and support defect analysis and yield improvement within our 300 mm manufacturing facility.

The Role:

Spire is making a fundamental shift in how it operates its constellation. We are moving from a model where trained operators watch dashboards and escalate to experts, to one where the system is fully autonomous, self-healing, and data intelligent. This Director will lead that transformation. You will set the technical vision, define the architecture, build and inspire the team, and personally raise the standard for what modern space operations look like. 

The old model relies on operators, escalations, manual processes, and institutional knowledge locked in the heads of a few experts. It does not scale and it does not belong in a modern space company. We know what we want to replace it with: SRE principles applied to a constellation, autonomous fault handling, AI-driven anomaly detection, low toil, high data quality, and continuous improvement baked into the system.

This is not a role for someone who wants to graduate out of technical work. If your ideal week is back-to-back 1:1s, sprint ceremonies, and stakeholder syncs, this is not the right fit. summary: Qui sommes-nous ?  Q ENERGY France est un acteur majeur du marché des énergies renouvelables en France. Autrefois affilié au groupe RES, l’entreprise œuvre depuis 27 ans dans le développement, la…
description:
Qui sommes-nous ? 
Q ENERGY France est un acteur majeur du marché des énergies renouvelables en France. Autrefois affilié au groupe RES, l’entreprise œuvre depuis 27 ans dans le développement, la construction et l’exploitation de projets éoliens et photovoltaïques.  

Aujourd'hui également positionnée sur le marché du stockage d'énergie, Q ENERGY poursuit son expansion vers de nouveaux domaines afin de proposer des solutions intelligentes et complètes pour la production et la fourniture d’énergie durable en France. 

L'entreprise compte près de 300 collaborateur.rice.s et 6 agences sur le territoire ainsi qu'un siège social basé à Avignon. Q ENERGY France est une entreprise de la holding européenne Q ENERGY Solutions, créée en 2021 par Hanwha Solutions dans l'objectif de conduire à la prochaine génération de production d'énergie verte et flexible en Europe. Basée à Berlin, Q ENERGY Solutions est une société sœur de Q CELLS, fabricant de modules photovoltaïques reconnu à travers le monde. Les deux sociétés constituent la division Energie du groupe Hanwha Solutions, basé à Séoul. 

Vos missions : 
Vous serez support au pilotage et à l'animation d'études d'impacts sur l'environnement de parcs éoliens et centrales solaires comprenant notamment le volet naturel, le volet paysager et des études spécifiques.  
Vous serez en lien avec l'équipe projet, les autorités et les spécialistes pour identifier et traiter l'ensemble des risques environnementaux des projets. 
Vous participerez…

We’re a profitable, fast-growing scale-up with $43M raised and over $100M in annual revenue. Having recently launched in New York City, we’re expanding rapidly across the US and EMEA. If you take pride in your craft and want to help shape the next chapter of our growth, we'd love to hear from you.

Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About the role

YAMU Media is a performance marketing agency that builds and scales paid social for ecommerce and lead-gen brands. We are hiring full-time remote video editors based in the Philippines to turn creative briefs and scripts into Meta, TikTok and YouTube ads that hit their numbers.

This is not a brand-film or wedding-video role. Every edit you make is tested against hook rate, hold rate, CTR and cost per purchase or lead. You'll report to the Creative Lead and work alongside our media buyers, copywriters and strategists.

What you'll do

Edit short-form direct-response video ads (6–60 seconds) for Meta Reels, Stories and Feed, TikTok and YouTube Shorts, in 9:16, 4:5 and 1:1.

Turn UGC creator footage, founder clips, product b-roll and stock into ads that follow the script and brief exactly, then add your own ideas on top.

Build 3–5 hook variants per concept (different opening lines, visuals and text overlays) so the media team can test which first 3 seconds stop the scroll.

Iterate on proven winners: re-cut top performers with new hooks, new pacing, new offers or new creators when the media team flags fatigue.

Add captions, kinetic text, on-screen callouts, sound design, music and simple motion graphics that support the message rather than decorate it.

About Vana
Vana is the open network for user-owned data: people decide where their data goes and who trains AI on it, and share in what it creates. Builders reach it through UU API a tool developed by OpenDataLabs () on the Vana Network, the developer gateway to the protocol. Vana is build on the Personal Data Portability Protocol (PDPP) (), an open standard hosted with the Linux Foundation Decentralized Trust that underpins the way users permission their data across applications and services. 
The role
You are Vana's face to the developers and product managers who build on UU API, PDPP and the protocol, and to builders at large. You own every builder relationship that touches the protocol, from a first question in Discord to a running node. About a fifth of the job is building and tinkering. The rest is developing programmes, demo-ing, working with our content team to develop builder-facing content, and managing the builders that touch our ecosystem. This is a Vana Foundation role, and you report directly to the Managing Director. 
What you will do

Set the developer marketing strategy and guide the marketing team's campaigns and content. The content team creates; you decide what gets made and why.

Run the Builder Incentives Programme and the programmes that get data connectors built, tested and maintained. In time, run the node operator network.

Be in the room, on site. Run workshops with buyers and key users, debug alongside their IT, and see how a company really buys instead of how the process documentation says it buys.

What you'll do
Find the problems worth solving, then solve them end to end. Sit with buyers and procurement leads, work out what actually costs them money, decide what's worth building, and ship it to production, with AI doing much of the heavy lifting. You're done when it drives revenue, not when it's released. Don't wait for a PRD: make the case, or skip the case and show the prototype.

Because of AI, we only hire Builders. No specialized roles. At Tacto, some of our Builders come from product, some from engineering, some from founding their own company. They all have one thing in common: they take a messy, unclear problem and own it from start to finish, whether it's a customer problem or a business problem. description:
Mission Brief 

You are the guardian and the challenger of our security posture. At Isar Aerospace, the systems that build our rockets and the ground systems that launch them are mission critical, and protecting them takes more than good design. It takes someone who will attack their own work to be sure it holds. 

We are looking for a deeply hands-on Senior Security Engineer. You live in the consoles, the rule sets and the code. You own our secure access and network security controls, our endpoint and identity security stack, and our detection content, and you operate them yourself rather than directing from the sidelines. You wear two hats: the Builder who implements and runs the controls that keep us safe, and the Adversary who keeps testing whether those controls and detections actually fire. 

This is a senior engineering role with the spirit of an architect. You are expected to design what you operate, not just configure it: pick the pattern, write it down, and make it hold at fleet scale. A versatile engineer with real depth, comfortable switching from a firewall rule set to a detection query to a directory hardening sprint in the same week, and a technical anchor others lean on. 

Your Role in Our Space Mission 

SASE and Network Security 

Own and operate our SASE platform, including revamping Internet Security policies and redefining Private Access policies.

The Logistics Tribe builds the systems powering end-to-end delivery across North America, Europe and Australia/New Zealand: getting fresh ingredients into our facilities, giving customers the best delivery options the network can support, and tracking every box to the customer's door. That is reflected in how we work: rather than one fixed squad, the team organises into small, project-focused pods that form and dissolve as projects start and finish. In a typical sprint, your engineers might be spread across three projects with three different product managers.

Strategy and technical direction are things we shape together - staff engineers, product managers and you all contributing, nobody working from a script handed down. You own the people and the delivery of your engineers.

The role reports to the Director of Engineering for Logistics Tech; your team is spread across two geographies.

How anyone with a good reason to speak to customers can do it safely and in minutes.

One of Quandela's priority is demonstrating fault tolerant quantum computing. We are widely known for our boson samplers, where one source can provide many photons, but for FTQC we will do spin-spin operations, mediated by photons with a dash of entanglement. So, instead of many photons from few sources, we need many photons from many spins. That means that someone has to ; every day, for months ; test many "spin-photon sources" together and determine whether the photons have adequate properties (single, indistinguishable, entangled), and other things. Where you will help, is making these measurements less tedious, by making some of it automated. For instance, by rotating waveplates by the right amount and in the right order at the right time. High urgency: Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly. 

Product taste: Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge - you will often be "the PM".

Security mindset: A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

description:
Over Nedlin
Nedlin is een industriële textielverzorger voor Healthcare, Hospitality en Industry, waar veiligheid, kwaliteit, continu verbeteren en verantwoord ondernemen centraal staan. Als groeiend B-Corp familiebedrijf investeren we graag in jong talent en versterken we de verbinding tussen onderwijs en arbeidsmarkt. Daarom bieden we studenten de kans om praktijkervaring op te doen, zich te ontwikkelen en Nedlin te leren kennen, met waar mogelijk mooie doorgroeikansen na het afstuderen.

De stageopdracht
Tijdens deze hbo-stage ga je aan de slag met Lock Out Tag Out (LOTO). LOTO is een veiligheidsmethode waarbij machines en energiebronnen tijdens onderhoud of werkzaamheden veilig worden uitgeschakeld en vergrendeld. Zo wordt voorkomen dat een machine onverwacht wordt ingeschakeld terwijl eraan wordt gewerkt. Jij helpt Nedlin om deze werkwijze verder te ontwikkelen, te standaardiseren en praktisch toepasbaar te maken.

Je onderzoekt de huidige LOTO-werkwijze en brengt risico’s, energiebronnen en isolatiepunten in kaart.

Je ontwikkelt een uniforme LOTO-procedure en machine-specifieke LOTO-kaarten.

Je brengt de benodigde materialen en hulpmiddelen in kaart.

Je ontwikkelt instructie- en toolboxmateriaal voor medewerkers.

Je stelt een praktisch implementatieadvies op om LOTO binnen Nedlin verder te borgen.

Wat bieden wij?

Who we are

About Privy

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. We get to solve hard technical problems while leveraging Stripe's distribution to reach customers like Ramp, Klarna, Deel, Kraken, Hyperliquid, and Fomo — powering experiences for both mainstream users and crypto natives.

About the team

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by

High urgency—Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly

Product taste—Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge—you will often be "the PM."

Security mindset—A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

Who we are
About Bridge

We're creating an entirely new payments platform, built with stablecoins, to simplify global money movement. Bridge enables faster, cheaper payments and borderless access to dollars via stablecoins. Through our APIs, businesses can send and receive funds across borders faster and cheaper vs. SWIFT and other fiat-only rails. Our virtual accounts enable international consumers and businesses to easily access, store, and spend US dollars. Our payouts infrastructure enables platforms to disburse USD to anyone globally. We believe many trillions of dollars will move and settle through stablecoin payment rails. Bridge is pulling this future forward.

We have a small team of people who have previously built financial infrastructure at some of the world's leading companies (Coinbase, Stripe, Square, Brex, Upstart, DoorDash, Airbnb), and each and every one of them chose Bridge because they fundamentally believe that stablecoins will be a critical piece of financial infrastructure that allows for the improvement of global money movement.

As an early member of the Bridge engineering team, you'll have the autonomy to work on projects that are truly global in scale and aim to give customers access to products they've never had access to. description:
Who we are

About Privy

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. We get to solve hard technical problems while leveraging Stripe's distribution to reach customers like Ramp, Klarna, Deel, Kraken, Hyperliquid, and Fomo — powering experiences for both mainstream users and crypto natives.

Learn more about Privy: Privy and Stripe: Bringing crypto to everyone

About the team

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by:

High urgency: Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly. 

Product taste: Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge - you will often be "the PM".

Security mindset: A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

Who we are

About Privy

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. We get to solve hard technical problems while leveraging Stripe's distribution to reach customers like Ramp, Klarna, Deel, Kraken, Hyperliquid, and Fomo — powering experiences for both mainstream users and crypto natives.

About the team

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by:

High urgency—Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly. 

Product taste—Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge —you will often be "the PM".

Security mindset—A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low-latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Global Business Services’ (GBS) primary goal is to ensure operational excellence across deal cycles, increase revenue through the development of transformative commercial constructs, and drive closure of Stripe’s deal portfolio. The team's reach is widespread across Stripe, not exclusive to one sales segment or geographical region; GBS drives change across go-to-market, positively impacting Stripe users and cross-functional teams. GBS’s priorities are set through the direction of Stripe leadership and executive vision, partnership with sales and cross-functional organizations, as well as user feedback and market insights.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible.

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the…

Open Issuance is central to that opportunity. Built by Bridge, a Stripe company, it enables businesses to launch and manage their own stablecoins.
